instance-segmentation.description: Segments individual Arabidopsis leaves using instance segmentation. Use for rosette leaf counting and area measurement from close-range RGB images.
Segments potato leaves using Leaf-only SAM. Use for potato leaf instance segmentation from close-range RGB images.

image-classification.description: Classifies winter wheat canopy for nutrient deficiency from UAV aerial images using DINOv2 with LoRA. Trained on CVPPA 2023 Dikopshof LTFE dataset. Superseded by Naren1704 full fine-tune model for general use.
Classifies rice leaves for nitrogen deficiency severity — mild, moderate, severe, very severe. Use for close-range RGB rice leaf images.
Classifies wheat canopy for nutrient deficiency from UAV aerial drone images. Use for field-scale wheat UAV imagery, not close-range leaf images.
Classifies maize (corn) leaves for multiple nutrient deficiency types. Use for close-range RGB maize leaf images.
Classifies banana leaves for micronutrient deficiency including zinc, calcium, magnesium. Use for close-range RGB banana leaf images.
Classifies coffee leaves for multiple micronutrient deficiency types. Use for close-range RGB coffee leaf images.

object-detection.description: Detects and counts rice panicles from UAV aerial images. Use for rice yield estimation and reproductive organ counting from drone imagery.
Detects and counts wheat spikes and heads from field images. Use for wheat yield estimation and spike counting from close-range or field RGB images.

temporal-analysis.description: Analyses Sentinel-2 satellite image time series for crop type classification, growth rate prediction, and harvest timing estimation across 21 crop types.
